dedupe_keys.name: global downscaled projections for climate impacts research

description: GDPCIR is the Climate Impact Lab's global dataset of bias-corrected and downscaled CMIP6 projections. It supplies daily minimum and maximum surface air temperature and precipitation from 25 climate models on a quarter-degree grid, for historical conditions and four SSP scenarios. Historical series cover 1950–2014; projections run from 2015 to 2099 or 2100, depending on the source model, without leap days. Partitioned Zarr stores use time, latitude and longitude dimensions. Data are free under CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 according to the model collection; the repository's processing code is MIT. A limitation is that not all model-scenario-variable combinations exist, and statistical downscaling preserves selected distributions without resolving local infrastructure geometry. GDPCIR can supply forcing for climate-adaptation simulations. ERA5 (data-era5-reanalysis) supplies its bias-correction reference. This record also covers the documented downscaleCMIP6 production workflow. Only repository and STAC collection metadata were inspected; no climate arrays were downloaded.
